audit_events_unverified_idx.name: audit_events_unverified_idx
audit_events_unverified_idx.where: "audit_events"."shipped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_events"."verified_at" IS NULL

approval_proposals_self_ck.name: approval_proposals_self_ck
approval_proposals_self_ck.value: "approval_proposals"."maker_id" IS NULL OR "approval_proposals"."checker_id" IS NULL OR "approval_proposals"."maker_id" <> "approval_proposals"."checker_id" OR "approval_proposals"."bootstrap"

approval_proposals_open_ck.name: approval_proposals_open_ck
approval_proposals_open_ck.value: "approval_proposals"."status" <> 'SUBMITTED' OR ("approval_proposals"."maker_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_proposals"."checker_id" IS NOT NULL)

approval_proposals_decider_ck.name: approval_proposals_decider_ck
approval_proposals_decider_ck.value: "approval_proposals"."decided_by" IS NULL OR "approval_proposals"."maker_id" IS NULL OR "approval_proposals"."decided_by" <> "approval_proposals"."maker_id" OR "approval_proposals"."bootstrap" OR "approval_proposals"."status" IN ('WITHDRAWN','VOID')

user_permission_grants_cleared_ck.name: user_permission_grants_cleared_ck
user_permission_grants_cleared_ck.value: "user_permission_grants"."cleared_by" IS NULL OR "user_permission_grants"."cleared_at" IS NOT NULL

exception_reports_signed_ck.name: exception_reports_signed_ck
exception_reports_signed_ck.value: "exception_reports"."status" <> 'SIGNED' OR ("exception_reports"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exception_reports"."signed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "exception_reports"."signature" IS NOT NULL AND "exception_reports"."key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "exception_reports"."public_key_pem" IS NOT NULL)
